name: tr_rj
caption:
IF RJ WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🦖 Tyrunt, the hometown kid: born right here in Toronto
🐍 Seviper, the Maple Mamba: nicknamed for playing like Kobe
🥉 Bronzong, the medal: sealed Canada's World Cup bronze over the USA
🐦 Dodrio, the triple-double: 25 points, 10 rebounds, 15 assists
🔥 Magmortar, the big stage: playoff career-high 33 points vs Cleveland
🐉 Salamence, the ace: our scorer, 21.6 points a night through 9 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Barrett was born in Toronto; nicknamed the Maple Mamba due to his playstyle resemblance to Kobe Bryant; sealed Canada's victory over the United States with a 3 point shot to win bronze at the 2023 FIBA World Cup; first career triple-double: 25 points, 10 rebounds and 15 assists (November 16, 2024); April 24, 2026, Game 3 vs Cleveland: playoff career-high 33 points; selected third overall (#3) in the 2019 draft
